assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis code I47.1 is used for supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code G45.9 is used for transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated due to the intermittent nature of symptoms and the need to correlate arrhythmic events with neurological deficits
The CPT code 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The payer denied the service under code PR-204
The requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The denial is based on the member's current benefit plan coverage limitations
